scope: CD08 stale-file detector on the code-diet service's own src (detect_drift, #17)
signal: git log -1 --format=%ct per file, injected as fileGitAges (spec §8 no-FS)

fp_floor.contract: CD08 on a file with age <= threshold is a false positive

recall.contract: a file with age > threshold gets a CD08 warn
recall.pass: n/a (no stale files in a fresh repo)
